FOUNDER & DIRECTOR

Pavneet Singh

Pavneet Singh is presented in Plexus’s public materials as a Halifax-based real estate developer. His work with the group focuses on identifying opportunities, building relationships and coordinating a practical path from land and planning to development.

Plexus’s published materials connect his perspective to real estate advisory, investment opportunities and community-minded project growth. A fuller transaction history and professional credentials should be added only after verification.
